text.en:
the following subdivisions known as BF Homes Parañaque, Teoville, Goodwill Phase II,
Iren-ville, Sta. Rita Village and Jackielou in Barangay San Dionisio, in the Municipality of Parañaque, Metro
Manila, is hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent
barangay which is created to be known as Barangay BF Homes without affecting in any manner the legal
existence of the mother barangay.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to Barangay BF Homes.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay San Dionisio shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly created Barangay BF Homes until the barangay officials of said barangay
shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors
shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this Decree and
shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and
employees as maybe necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of Barangay BF Homes
shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay BF Homes in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay San Dionisio shall be transferred by the President to
the newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or part of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Eighty.
